scope: HiTrap Blue HP 1 mL/5 mL and reviewed general IEX/HIC/SEC topics; exact labels and aliases below are approved technical design, not changes to the approved source policy.
label_normalization: Map Unicode whitespace to ASCII spaces; trim and collapse repeated spaces
Do not remove punctuation, words, size qualifiers or accents; do not use substring/fuzzy matching

products.reviewed_alias_note: Alias rows approved as technical catalog design under T03 on 2026-10-25; not runtime activation or new scientific/source approval.

methods.restriction: Preserve the subtype; family membership does not approve the withheld pH/pI condition.

resolution_rules: One exact normalized label entry resolves; no score threshold.
Ambiguous label remains ambiguous, even if only one in-scope product is implemented.
Known out-of-scope label is identified but unsupported; unknown label remains unresolved.
An explicit size in a qualified label is recorded with that input origin; conflicting explicit column fields require clarification, never overwrite.
Do not inherit product or column context across tasks.
Source passages naming several products do not make their identities equivalent.
